wholePhysicalScope: Microsoft supplies the merged main ranges; Overture corroborates the eastern exhibition rectangle. The named library outline and museum boundary come from OpenStreetMap.

limitations: The major roof ranges follow Microsoft and Overture footprints. Both original Bellman halls are documented. The allocation of their roof sections within these merged footprints remains an exterior reconstruction.

Roof heights, the transition between original and later roof ranges, door alterations, windows, colors and finished floor heights are estimates. The building forms use the published South African Bellman type.
The open paths and named library follow available map controls. The collection interiors, outdoor military objects and the separately sited war memorial are outside the model.
